resources.string: Strava, Komoot, Garmin Connect and most apps import the file: choose one in the share menu. With Health Connect, the outing is also written there.
No trace to share for this outing

When you share an outing, skimap writes it to Health Connect: a skiing session with its start and end time, its route (the positions recorded during the outing), its name, the recap, the distance and the climb. skimap reads only the heart rate of the hours of that outing (from a watch, if you have one), to put it into the file you share. Nothing else is read, and the app sends this data nowhere by itself: the file goes only to the app you choose. You can remove the permissions at any time in the Health Connect settings.
